title: Thunderbolt
description: A simple modpack that doesn't have bloat and is purely optimization mods (except 'OK Zoomer') so you can add your own. Please note that this is tuned for nvidia gpus, specifically ones that are 16xx or newer.
body:
# This modpack is a modpack **without any¹ bloat**.

**Sadly, Thunderbolt does require some setup (read recommended)**

This modpack is made **SPECIFICALLY** for the people who **don't want bloat**/want something to base their own modpack off of

## Why Thunderbolt?

This modpack has compatibility with android, PC, etc.

This modpack **_should_** run better then modpacks like _Fabulously Optimized_

## Recommended

**Recommended** to use these java options (its _ok to skip_ if you dont know what these are):

```
-XX:+UseZGC -Dchunky.maxWorkingCount=1024
```

..also preferrably **_C2ME-OCL_**, but thats just chunk loading speeds.

For the cherry on top, get [**_Nvidium_**](https://github.com/drouarb/nvidium/releases), this is **CRUCIAL** if you want performance, doubles mine, increases my 1% lows, makes my performance more stable, and makes 64 chunk render distance _nothing_

..but it doesnt work on **AMD** gpus, or _NVIDIA_ gpus that are older than the **_16xx_** series

Also, if you play with _very high_ render distances (even at 32, but the issue is more prominent at +32), it is recommended to use **_Longview_**, although that mod _isnt available on all versions_

Additionally, i dont **really** update this modpack unless theres a _decent_ improvement in performance, as its a pain to download it, change it, upload it, add a changelog, etc, just for a small performance upgrade. So _**please**_ take your time to click "Update All" or "Check for updates" if you want max performance.

Benchmarks with a **_RTX 3070_** and a **_Ryzen 5 5500_**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

```
INFO

Seed: 1234
Same position
Entities turned off
Tick frozen
No nvidium on thunderbolt
Tested with the 1st version of thunderbolt, so expect performance to be better than this.
Same settings, render distance 16
Time: 

TESTS

Thunderbolt: 1117 fps, 1% low 481, 0.1% low 354, average 1070, consistent fps
Adrenaline: 823fps, 1% low 77, 0.1% 41, average 583, VERY inconsistent fps
Fabulously optimized: 731 fps, 1% low 51, 0.1% low 21, average 445, consistent-ish fps
```

</details>

### The cons?
if you want the max fps, you have to manually install some mods due to legal reasons

you might have to update mods yourself if the modpack goes unupdated for awhile


DISCLAIMER: This modpack is tuned to **_Nvidia gpus_**, due to the mod **_Nvidium_**, however it should still work on AMD and <16xx Nvidia gpus.

¹ besides _OK Zoomer_.
